public.text: The Facility Registry and Workforce Registry are listed separately, but health service discovery often depends on organisations, locations, practitioners, practitioner roles, services, and relationships among them. The proposed boundaries may not fully represent the mCSD model cited later.
public.suggestedRevision: Clarify how organisations, facilities or locations, practitioners, practitioner roles, services, and organisational affiliations are distributed across components and queried as a coherent service directory.
